400deed3420a99dd2ae092e1f280982958b38b90.source: 视频教程：<s id="0">观看本章视频</s>。
400deed3420a99dd2ae092e1f280982958b38b90.translation: Video tutorial: <s id="0">watch this chapter's video</s>.

f5fd443833641975ebf6cc8ced03e4c92bd5e0dd.source: 生理参数合成把舌位、唇形、软腭等构形与声门声源连起来。可以边调边听，也可以把多个姿势排成一段动作，保存带声音的视频。第一次使用，先从一个预设和一段短音开始。
f5fd443833641975ebf6cc8ced03e4c92bd5e0dd.translation: Articulatory synthesis connects configurations of the tongue, lips and velum with a glottal source. Listen while adjusting a posture, or arrange several postures into a sequence and save a video with sound. Begin with a preset and a short preview.

9e8bb0a71d576a5d042df313af5ed4e55d7fabec.source: 在左侧模块列表打开生理参数合成，等到头部模型和声学图出现。桌面应用在本机计算，无需登录。网页版优先加载浏览器本地计算组件，首次加载失败时才使用服务器回退，具体限制以页面提示为准。
9e8bb0a71d576a5d042df313af5ed4e55d7fabec.translation: Open Articulatory synthesis from the module list on the left and wait for the head model and acoustic plots. The desktop application computes locally without login. The web version first loads its browser computation component and uses the server fallback only if initial loading fails. Check the page for the active limits.

2e083296e48be521873417689030fd33394bec60.source: 在模型下方的构形起点点击 a。模型、面积函数和传递函数会一起更新。
2e083296e48be521873417689030fd33394bec60.translation: Click a under Configuration starting points below the model. Model, area function, and transfer function update together.

c601b62b088b33acb19bffffecea227521bcb828.source: 点击右侧声音页签，在声音输出中选择要使用的扬声器或耳机，把试听音量调低一些。
c601b62b088b33acb19bffffecea227521bcb828.translation: Open the Sound tab on the right, select speakers or headphones under Audio output, and lower listening volume.

2757ac9b467dd76021e9e1a6caddf7e5dd530fa5.source: 点击 <s id="0">发声 1 秒</s>，等待合成后听一段短音。网页版按钮为发声 0.5 秒。需要边调边听且持续发声可用时，点击持续发声，再点变为停止播放的同一个按钮结束。
2757ac9b467dd76021e9e1a6caddf7e5dd530fa5.translation: Click <s id="0">Phonate for 1 second</s> and wait for the short preview. The web button previews 0.5 seconds. When continuous phonation is available, click Continuous phonation to listen while adjusting, then click the same button, now labelled Stop playback, to finish.

617dfd316aa118ed910d92cfbfa405230da7e311.source: <s id="0">如果提示正在更新构形，请稍候再点发声。</s>在清声或耳语模式下没有明显声音时，先切回浊声 · 周期振动完成这次练习。
617dfd316aa118ed910d92cfbfa405230da7e311.translation: <s id="0">If Configuration updating appears, wait before clicking Phonate again.</s> If unvoiced or whisper mode is very quiet, return to Voiced · periodic vibration for this exercise.

473cd3b32fe889eb28e8bddf7b8665557b1770e6.source: 打开工作区与找到控件
473cd3b32fe889eb28e8bddf7b8665557b1770e6.translation: Open the workspace and locate controls

e7e60b4a162f4fb6a02344945e010425547650eb.source: 工作区中，模型负责观察和拖动，声学分析区显示面积、传递函数与横截面，右侧操作面板分为器官、声音、序列。窗口较窄时，声学分析区会移到模型下方。右侧内容超出可见范围时，用滚轮向下查看。
e7e60b4a162f4fb6a02344945e010425547650eb.translation: Use the model for inspection and dragging. The acoustic area shows the area function, transfer function and cross-section. The right panel has Organs, Sound and Sequence tabs. In narrow windows the acoustic area moves below the model. Scroll down to reach controls outside the visible panel.

cf3acbc93ae6a5c1214a3bda6b246a3f0c1430b4.source: 器官页中拖动模型圆点，右侧调整参数；下方同时查看面积、截面和传递函数。
cf3acbc93ae6a5c1214a3bda6b246a3f0c1430b4.translation: Drag model dots in Organs and adjust parameters on the right, while inspecting area, cross-section, and transfer function below.

6b9a7eea4294a4c4052c9a2cebce7c63eee393da.source: 模型下方的构形起点、已存构型、保存构形用于当前姿势。序列页签中可从国际音标生成序列、保存当前姿势、添加静音帧、编辑塞音时序、播放和导入导出文件。参数控制标题旁的帮助打开本章，方法与引用查看模型说明与来源。
6b9a7eea4294a4c4052c9a2cebce7c63eee393da.translation: The configuration starting points, saved configurations and save control below the model operate on the current posture. In the Sequence tab you can generate a sequence from IPA, capture the current posture, add silence, edit stop timing, play the sequence and import or export files. Help beside the parameter-control heading opens this chapter; Methods and references describes the model and its sources.

1f4004edf762035041a6d68f810240630754b02d.source: 用发声按钮开始试听，切换到其他模块会停止声音。退出后，下次可从模块列表重新打开。
1f4004edf762035041a6d68f810240630754b02d.translation: Start listening with phonation buttons. Switching modules stops sound. Reopen later from the module list.

cbd0eba0706d8651711e3cc7ad654cc6b727d1ce.source: 在二维和三维中观察与拖动
cbd0eba0706d8651711e3cc7ad654cc6b727d1ce.translation: Inspect and drag in two and three dimensions

e509be3a753680745ab46252562bd5b50f394aae.source: 在空白处按住鼠标拖动平移，滚轮围绕指针缩放。小舌、上下唇及其他正中控制点直接显示，无须先选中器官。侧缘控制点在三维和横截面中显示。拖动圆点改变构形；按住 Shift 拖动圆点位置可平移观察。
e509be3a753680745ab46252562bd5b50f394aae.translation: Drag blank space to pan; the wheel zooms about the pointer. Uvula, upper/lower lips, and other midline controls are directly visible without selecting an organ. Lateral-margin controls appear in three dimensions and cross-sections. Drag dots to change configuration; Shift-drag at dot positions pans the view.

bd2872963981f68cbfb9627f56de2657b8ac7140.source: 空白处左键拖动旋转，右键拖动平移，滚轮缩放。绿色圆点用于调节器官。
bd2872963981f68cbfb9627f56de2657b8ac7140.translation: Left-drag blank space to rotate, right-drag to pan, and wheel to zoom. Green dots adjust organs.

d431dd1a4bdbed25e958c80f78ff450f26316295.source: 查看整头 / 聚焦声道

12e5c98efa822030e9dd06b83d5aaaec60658ebe.source: 切换观察范围，不改器官参数。
12e5c98efa822030e9dd06b83d5aaaec60658ebe.translation: Switch viewing extent without changing organ parameters.

d7d15a36f8586f8719f4c541ce087ac6f32fbfb5.source: 恢复模型的观察方向、平移与缩放，不重置姿势。
d7d15a36f8586f8719f4c541ce087ac6f32fbfb5.translation: Restore orientation, pan, and zoom without resetting posture.

6dca19cae435a44b45865acdb185d17f3a83ee7d.source: 器官观察 / 气腔观察 / 叠加观察

be2c394f6a4ba311011b64938076d4438e445383.source: 分别看粉红色组织、青绿色气腔或两者叠加。青绿色表示空气空间。
be2c394f6a4ba311011b64938076d4438e445383.translation: Show pink tissue, turquoise air spaces, or both. Turquoise indicates air space.

c85d5c1174eb539a663fcadfd14ff9dab252653b.source: 头部轮廓 / 鼻腔 / 牙齿 / 标注
c85d5c1174eb539a663fcadfd14ff9dab252653b.translation: Head outline / Nasal cavity / Teeth / Labels

fdefa79ad7f98043c5e4f4ea698225644605ecdf.source: 分别控制可见性。隐藏牙齿后，牙齿的构形约束仍在。
fdefa79ad7f98043c5e4f4ea698225644605ecdf.translation: Control visibility independently. Hiding teeth retains their geometric constraints.

eb4e0fd21e880a56b89b5c8bd384065a85ecd2d2.source: 三维默认显示半侧，便于看内部。勾选后查看完整模型；旧视图偏好可能保留上次选择。
eb4e0fd21e880a56b89b5c8bd384065a85ecd2d2.translation: The default three-dimensional view shows one half for internal inspection. Select to see the full model; old view preferences may retain a previous choice.

a584a415382f624a4c2475775d43a5d117f1f37c.source: 点击模型中的舌头、嘴唇或软腭，可切换正在操作的器官及其圆点。声门高低点在二维和三维中常驻，无需先选软腭。二维圆点获得焦点后可用方向键微调，Shift 加方向键增大步长。
a584a415382f624a4c2475775d43a5d117f1f37c.translation: Click tongue, lips, or velum in the model to switch active organs and dots. Glottal-height dots persist in both views without selecting the velum. Focus a two-dimensional dot for arrow-key fine adjustment; Shift + arrows increases step size.

6d3c979e71941bc7840b3a657bcaa152413d825a.source: 观察时先放大要调整的部位，再用小幅拖动。模型离开画面就点击重置视角。
6d3c979e71941bc7840b3a657bcaa152413d825a.translation: Zoom into the region first and drag small distances. If the model leaves the view, Reset view.

a416a1c433d48d189e909fe000566b62f050affe.source: 三维视图默认显示半侧模型，全部器官圆点可直接拖动；空白区域拖动可转动观察。
a416a1c433d48d189e909fe000566b62f050affe.translation: Default half-model three-dimensional view with all organ dots directly draggable; drag blank space to rotate.

f5ab0f3aff1a404c57ea4267166237fdee327e9d.source: 勾选显示完整模型后可观察外部形态。再次取消勾选即可恢复半侧。
f5ab0f3aff1a404c57ea4267166237fdee327e9d.translation: Select Show complete model for external shape; clear it to return to one half.

54779cdd4e7d2866e7d6cf2343dddd1e39bbe50d.source: 先在构形起点中选接近目标的姿势，再到器官页签微调。a、i、u、e、o、ɛ、y、ø 为元音起点，l、n、t 为另外三个构形示例。<s id="0">预设提供构形起点，自存音标用来命名姿势；发音类别需结合输出声音判断。</s>
54779cdd4e7d2866e7d6cf2343dddd1e39bbe50d.translation: Choose a starting posture near the target, then refine in Organs. a, i, u, e, o, ɛ, y, ø are vowel starting points; l, n, t provide three other examples. <s id="0">Presets are configuration starting points; saved phonetic symbols name postures. Judge phonetic categories with output sound.</s>

3dd915565cb3db7398781b1e72cd6d8c437e6002.source: 下颌开合、唇前突、唇开度分别控制开口和唇形。侧面上唇、下唇圆点可前后、上下拖动。
3dd915565cb3db7398781b1e72cd6d8c437e6002.translation: Jaw opening, lip protrusion, and lip opening control aperture and shape separately. Side-view upper/lower lip dots drag horizontally and vertically.

5a854aa3d50c4d9434a504b8370a0d569b1345e4.source: 范围 55%–160%，初始为 100%。拖动滑块或正面示意图的左右圆点，左右宽度随之改变，上下开度仍单独控制。
5a854aa3d50c4d9434a504b8370a0d569b1345e4.translation: Range 55%–160%, initial 100%. Use the slider or frontal left/right dots; vertical opening remains independent.

31dbce523d398e44f981a599e6e5856a9796de17.translation: Link jaw opening to lip opening

639e1efce40dfe83286a68e58b74aea1a8d1c9ba.source: 默认勾选。调整下颌时联动唇开度；需要分开调时取消勾选。
639e1efce40dfe83286a68e58b74aea1a8d1c9ba.translation: Selected by default. Jaw adjustment links lip opening; clear for independent control.

62b5de5f3050ae84c8fb53957a766e4a3a4f3f2b.source: 舌背、舌叶、舌尖各有前后和高低滑块，也可拖动相应圆点。舌面圆点位于舌叶与舌根之间，舌底圆点位于口底附着与舌尖之间，默认随其他点运动，也可单独拖动进行平滑局部调整。重置舌头恢复随形状态。舌底继续避让下牙和下颌，口底附着相对下颌固定。
62b5de5f3050ae84c8fb53957a766e4a3a4f3f2b.translation: Tongue body, blade, and tip have front/back and height sliders and corresponding dots. The surface dot lies between blade and root; the underside dot between floor attachment and tip. Both follow other points by default but can be dragged for smooth local adjustment. Reset tongue restores following. The underside avoids lower teeth/jaw; floor attachment remains fixed relative to jaw.

362640bd05c6da7792983c8c3906db0a237c3099.source: 拖动舌根或调整舌根滑块会自动开启手动舌根。取消手动舌根后恢复自动联动。
362640bd05c6da7792983c8c3906db0a237c3099.translation: Dragging root or changing its slider enables Manual tongue root automatically. Clear it for automatic linkage.

daeddbd91f19b1ce67dc997824b5501c04b9b5c0.source: 用舌骨前后、舌骨高低滑块或对应圆点调整。
daeddbd91f19b1ce67dc997824b5501c04b9b5c0.translation: Adjust hyoid front/back or height sliders, or corresponding dots.

bb5349efba83c1bb589849e04b82223ae4026d63.source: 相对舌骨的独立偏移，范围 −1 至 1 cm，初始为 0。用滑块或常驻圆点调整。
bb5349efba83c1bb589849e04b82223ae4026d63.translation: Independent offset relative to hyoid, −1 to 1 cm, initially 0. Use slider or persistent dot.

941287d9e1892b583befcf8bc9b4bcb2683beab1.source: 后、中、前侧缘分别调整，左右联动；可在三维或当前横截面中拖动。前侧缘抬升可形成两侧支撑与中央沟槽，下降可形成中央接触与两侧通路。气腔避让牙齿，隐藏牙齿仍保留约束。口底附着参考向舌根方向后移，相对下颌固定，舌腹端随构形移动，舌头下缘受到下颌内壁和下牙约束，越过下牙后连续接向舌尖。口底点用于表示模型的固定附着关系。舌叶向内下凹受到限制，舌背与舌尖之间保持平滑过渡。
941287d9e1892b583befcf8bc9b4bcb2683beab1.translation: Adjust posterior, middle, and anterior margins separately with linked left/right sides, in three dimensions or current cross-section. Raising anterior margins can form bilateral support with a central groove; lowering can create central contact with lateral paths. Air spaces avoid teeth, retaining constraints when teeth are hidden. The floor attachment reference is shifted toward the root and fixed relative to jaw; the ventral endpoint follows configuration. The lower tongue is constrained by inner jaw and lower teeth and joins the tip continuously beyond them. The floor point represents fixed model attachment. Blade inward/downward concavity is limited, retaining smooth body-to-tip transition.

bcd5a5c489c1ca7bd8495c0992f353baf3e36273.source: 参数滑块旁会显示当前数值。拖动后，模型与声学图同步更新。抵达参数范围或组织限制时，会显示已达到器官约束等提示，圆点可能无法继续跟随指针。此时以实际显示构形为准，不必反复用力拖动。
bcd5a5c489c1ca7bd8495c0992f353baf3e36273.translation: Current values appear beside sliders. Dragging updates model and acoustic plots together. At parameter or tissue limits, messages such as Articulator constraint reached appear and dots may stop following the pointer. Use the actual displayed configuration; repeated forceful dragging is unnecessary.

64faf676e36ba66178f2eafcf5924da7b20e4e4a.source: 舌叶圆点贴在组织表面，舌尖与声门高低圆点可分别拖动；修改后可撤销。
64faf676e36ba66178f2eafcf5924da7b20e4e4a.translation: Blade dot on tissue surface; tongue tip and glottal-height dots drag independently, with undo after changes.

198a35181b7d5b2badb4c32d6f249080e4f54633.source: 唇宽和唇形正视图可一起核对。其他器官控制在同一页向下滚动查看。
198a35181b7d5b2badb4c32d6f249080e4f54633.translation: Check lip width against the frontal lip diagram. Scroll down on the same tab for other organs.

034e12e0433d853da5ea11ff7aa0f8c1ec4074d8.source: 需要恢复上一步时，点击器官页签里的撤销、重做，也可用 Ctrl+Z、Ctrl+Shift+Z。重置舌头、重置唇与下颌或重置软腭与咽部只恢复所选器官的一组参数。要从完整 /a/ 构形重新开始，点下方构形起点中的 a；载入内置起点也会恢复该起点的声源与模型默认基频。
034e12e0433d853da5ea11ff7aa0f8c1ec4074d8.translation: Use Undo and Redo in the Organs tab, or Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z. Reset tongue, Reset lips and jaw, and Reset velum and pharynx restore only their respective parameter groups. To restart from a complete /a/ configuration, choose a below the model. Loading a built-in starting point also restores its source and the model's default fundamental frequency.

e9b9f98eb63b16ef6c2c1260ecd59967744a822f.translation: Open or close the velopharyngeal port

0a563526025cc9b65470853e6d242e81cacc62ef.source: 到器官页签下方找到腭咽口，可点击其标题在模型中选中软腭。
0a563526025cc9b65470853e6d242e81cacc62ef.translation: Find Velopharyngeal port lower in Organs; its heading selects the velum in the model.

820077097e9a97bb41631c69d046de6188b42ec5.source: 点击已关闭 / 已开放按钮切换口鼻连接，或拖动开口面积滑块作小幅调整。软腭下降开放，抬起关闭；旁边状态显示口鼻气腔连通或软腭封闭入口。
820077097e9a97bb41631c69d046de6188b42ec5.translation: Click Closed/Open to switch oral/nasal coupling or adjust Opening area slightly. Lowering velum opens, raising closes; adjacent status shows oral/nasal air spaces connected or velum sealing the entrance.

ba6a9fc970e942dda1e5fa6e44979dc745ac67ad.source: 观察模型中的间隙和当前横截面下方的腭咽口读数。软腭形态和腭咽口开口面积是两个控件，按需要分别微调。
ba6a9fc970e942dda1e5fa6e44979dc745ac67ad.translation: Inspect the gap in the model and the port readout below Current cross-section. Velum shape and port opening area are separate controls; adjust each as needed.

d9a9404b87a376d9b71fe2bcab6492372bed0d8d.source: 保持元音口腔通路默认勾选。某些舌位下，开放过大可能新产生口腔闭塞，软件会限制接受的开口并显示实际面积。研究闭塞时可取消勾选，再结合面积图检查。<s id="0">鼻腔显示勾选框只改变画面，口鼻是否连通要看腭咽口设置。</s>
d9a9404b87a376d9b71fe2bcab6492372bed0d8d.translation: Preserve vowel oral passage is selected by default. At some tongue positions, excessive opening can create a new oral closure; software limits accepted opening and shows actual area. Clear this for closure studies and inspect area plots. <s id="0">Nasal-cavity visibility affects display only; port settings determine oral/nasal coupling.</s>

fea244d053be52feb0647731f2179ec231a75072.source: 腭咽口滑块调整口鼻连接，实际面积与限制提示显示在控制旁。
fea244d053be52feb0647731f2179ec231a75072.translation: Port slider adjusts oral/nasal connection, with actual area and limit messages beside it.

559956dc8fe3fe28f36c630c475379c327a61967.source: 滑块旁的实际读数与提示一起核对，限制生效时以接受值为准。
559956dc8fe3fe28f36c630c475379c327a61967.translation: Read actual values and messages together; use accepted values when limits apply.

65e8f01713c1a45f18e85c7ade56fa49f2b95a65.source: 选取横截面并看面积变化

77bc74be63ea87d94f097791133eff58d7376e72.source: 在口腔声道面积函数上点击，或按住鼠标左右拖动。图上的竖线、声门至该处的距离读数、模型截面线和当前横截面会一起更新。
77bc74be63ea87d94f097791133eff58d7376e72.translation: Click or drag horizontally in the oral vocal-tract area plot. Its vertical line, distance from glottis, model section line, and Current cross-section update together.

bb663cd2a0388592bb3999cebc998c9ff71ff3d5.source: 要调整舌侧缘，先点击模型中的舌头，再在横截面下方选后侧缘、中侧缘或前侧缘。软件会定位到相应区域，拖动截面中的圆点调整，两侧联动。舌尖擦音需要抬高前侧缘，保留中央窄缝；前侧缘过低可能形成侧向通路并减弱齿前摩擦噪声。清声过轻时可在声音面板调节弱音增益。
bb663cd2a0388592bb3999cebc998c9ff71ff3d5.translation: For lateral margins, select the tongue in the model, then Posterior/Middle/Anterior margin below the cross-section. The software moves to that region; drag section dots with linked sides. Apical fricatives need raised anterior margins with a narrow central gap. Low anterior margins can create lateral paths and weaken pre-dental friction noise. Increase Quiet-sound gain if unvoiced sound is too weak.

174c890f818b830026fd3addca85952ad1be4ef8.source: 当前横截面固定采用 7 × 7 cm 视野，横纵等比例，左下标尺为 1 cm。同样大小的图窗中，切换姿势与截面不会自动放大某个狭窄位置，适合直接比较气腔变化。
174c890f818b830026fd3addca85952ad1be4ef8.translation: Current cross-section uses a fixed 7 × 7 cm field with equal aspect ratio and a 1 cm lower-left scale. At equal plot sizes, posture/section changes do not autozoom constrictions, enabling direct air-space comparison.

0dbbcdbaa06ee6b2d0bd5798670f7fbebfaeee20.source: 前舌侧缘可改变侧腔。面积图及截面随当前构形更新，截面保持相同比例。
0dbbcdbaa06ee6b2d0bd5798670f7fbebfaeee20.translation: Anterior lateral margins alter side cavities; area/section update with posture at constant scale.

d24cb80074bf9cfff59e2c0af179afa8363759d8.source: 当前几何截面积，横轴从声门到唇，距离为 cm，面积为 cm²。
d24cb80074bf9cfff59e2c0af179afa8363759d8.translation: Current geometric cross-sectional area. Horizontal axis runs glottis to lips in cm, area in cm².

0dcfc271e2e13a064ee5dde2d7a0086ad124a5c5.source: 合成使用的声学修正面积。它可能与几何面积不同。
0dcfc271e2e13a064ee5dde2d7a0086ad124a5c5.translation: Acoustically corrected area used in synthesis, potentially different from geometry.

4283ad1dd8ef62361154a0e005b7747861e4b21b.source: 看中央接触和两侧是否仍有通路。提示正中接触，侧面仍有通路时，两侧通路仍保持开放。
4283ad1dd8ef62361154a0e005b7747861e4b21b.translation: Inspect central contact and lateral paths. Central contact with side paths means both lateral passages remain open.

b1674bc210e38ff754f5b5ab2449cc791d7d9406.source: 当前模型的频率响应。下方 F1、F2、F3 来自曲线谱峰；腭咽口开放时改显示峰 1、峰 2、峰 3。
b1674bc210e38ff754f5b5ab2449cc791d7d9406.translation: Frequency response of the current model. F1, F2, F3 below are spectral peaks; an open port changes labels to Peak 1, Peak 2, Peak 3.

6d180480d22b3c5fc70838e16f7db973b4a5403e.source: 口腔面积图显示口腔通路，鼻腔分支需结合腭咽口设置观察。口腔局部闭塞时，开放的鼻通路仍可能传声。传递函数显示模型的频率响应，F0 曲线用于控制合成；输出声音的声学测量需另行开展。
6d180480d22b3c5fc70838e16f7db973b4a5403e.translation: Oral area plots show the oral path; inspect nasal branches with port settings. An open nasal path may transmit sound despite a local oral closure. Transfer functions show model response; F0 curves control synthesis. Measure actual output acoustics separately.

b83acdaddcb563f1498f2bdd6017738d02e8413d.source: 在序列页签中展开构形卡片的塞音时序，勾选分别控制闭塞、释放与浊音起始，再编辑闭塞、释放、送气和 VOT。下一构形是释放目标。旧文件中的独立送气帧仍可读取、排序和移除，F0 图中该段留白；启用塞音时序会合并紧随该帧的旧送气段。当前新建流程使用卡片内的送气时长，不再提供独立的添加送气帧按钮。
b83acdaddcb563f1498f2bdd6017738d02e8413d.translation: In the Sequence tab, expand Stop timing on a configuration card and enable separate control of closure, release and voicing onset. Edit closure, release, aspiration and VOT; the following configuration is the release target. Legacy standalone aspiration frames remain readable, sortable and removable, and appear blank in the F0 plot. Enabling stop timing merges immediately following legacy aspiration segments. New sequences use aspiration duration within the card; the separate Add aspiration frame button is no longer provided.

a53522f74a19b6e22460309eaa296b1bb3510618.translation: Set source, volume, and fundamental frequency

914de28bcd96025284256368acecffa8e4404d36.source: 点击声音页签，在声音输出中选好设备。设备刚切换或没有声音时，可点击测试音检查路由。测试音会实际发声，先确认音量合适。 WASAPI 输出采用共享模式，44.1 kHz 设备由播放端转换，原生合成与导出仍为 48 kHz。
914de28bcd96025284256368acecffa8e4404d36.translation: Choose a device under Audio output in Sound. After switching devices or if silent, Test tone checks routing and actually emits sound; check volume first. WASAPI uses shared mode. Playback converts for 44.1 kHz devices; native synthesis/export remain 48 kHz.

0af207a1793907111c51d40c166e68c36d08d1d6.source: 在声源模式中选浊声 · 周期振动、清声 · 不振动或耳语近似 · 后部缝隙。切换模式会载入该模式的声门初值，并保留当前驱动气压。
0af207a1793907111c51d40c166e68c36d08d1d6.translation: Select Voiced · periodic vibration, Unvoiced · no vibration, or Whisper approximation · posterior gap under Source mode. Switching loads glottal defaults for that mode while retaining driving pressure.

f769aeb573728175086b7d8e6027d32ace50b3e9.source: 拖动驱动气压、声门半宽、后部缝隙滑块微调。先用发声 1 秒听结果，再决定是否持续发声。
f769aeb573728175086b7d8e6027d32ace50b3e9.translation: Adjust Driving pressure, Glottal half-width, and Posterior gap. Listen with Phonate for 1 second before continuous phonation.

8fa48009e2faebd3a99647c680c2af76325851f9.source: 浊声模式可用基频 F0 滑块调音高。持续发声时修改器官或声源，声音会随当前构形更新。
8fa48009e2faebd3a99647c680c2af76325851f9.translation: In voiced mode, F0 controls pitch. During continuous phonation, organ/source changes update sound with the current configuration.

b0fc18285ef8d3f756c6bd661f9b7defbcb730b7.source: 声音控件的范围与初始值

90163a8d60d4ab6d7eb761a0edfbd5135d500edb.source: 60–350 Hz；男性 JD2 初始 120 Hz，女性 W02 初始 200 Hz
90163a8d60d4ab6d7eb761a0edfbd5135d500edb.translation: 60–350 Hz; initially 120 Hz for male JD2 and 200 Hz for female W02

5b1fca86743e9092c517d701e090bec0228accc5.source: 控制周期振动片段的音高。清声和耳语无周期振动时，当前 F0 不生效。
5b1fca86743e9092c517d701e090bec0228accc5.translation: Controls pitch in periodic segments. F0 is inactive without periodic vibration in unvoiced/whisper modes.

f0665a4749b06487fa9970fb42868f8c2872cf3d.source: 调节驱动气压，单位为 Pa。

4557ffa93635a03d4c0dec3eedcf39b254176f3f.source: 浊声初值 0.20 mm，清声 1.20 mm，耳语近似 0.05 mm。减小表示更内收。
4557ffa93635a03d4c0dec3eedcf39b254176f3f.translation: Initial voiced 0.20 mm, unvoiced 1.20 mm, whisper approximation 0.05 mm. Smaller means more adduction.

1a7147d500a8bfdcffc6d69d7ce4ae5ea50474df.source: 浊声初值 3 mm²，清声 6 mm²，耳语近似 4 mm²。
1a7147d500a8bfdcffc6d69d7ce4ae5ea50474df.translation: Initial voiced 3 mm², unvoiced 6 mm², whisper approximation 4 mm².

3c3560a32fa19a650c5e29df082dce86a31073d0.source: 送往选定设备的音量，已有设备与音量设置会保留。
3c3560a32fa19a650c5e29df082dce86a31073d0.translation: Volume sent to the chosen device; previous device/volume settings persist.

885a5833441d3c47ff56df121e42070fe7cde8fb.source: 仅放大监听信号，便于听较弱声音，不改变气压或声道面积。
885a5833441d3c47ff56df121e42070fe7cde8fb.translation: Amplifies monitoring only for weak sounds, without changing pressure or vocal-tract area.

3fb6e9136e73972c723f80e4b41c54bb39f3bbd0.source: 耳语近似默认还有 24 dB 试听补偿，提示行会显示，动作播放和视频音轨也使用它。比较声源强弱时需记录这项补偿。清声或耳语在低气压、较大开度等设置下可能很弱，实际噪声取决于气压和声门设置。
3fb6e9136e73972c723f80e4b41c54bb39f3bbd0.translation: Whisper approximation also defaults to 24 dB listening compensation, shown in the message line and used for motion playback/video tracks. Record this when comparing sources. Unvoiced/whisper can be weak at low pressure or large openings; actual noise depends on pressure and glottal settings.

605f02c2bc8ab5e354fd0fb233ac4194f9dbb65c.source: 耳语近似关闭周期振动，默认试听补偿为 24 dB。切回浊声后再调 F0。
605f02c2bc8ab5e354fd0fb233ac4194f9dbb65c.translation: Whisper approximation disables periodic vibration and defaults to 24 dB listening compensation. Return to Voiced before adjusting F0.

ddd6fc1538f3fc0054cd8eba193e43aa7c3c1097.source: 先选声源模式。耳语近似的试听补偿会改变听到的响度。
ddd6fc1538f3fc0054cd8eba193e43aa7c3c1097.translation: Select source mode first. Whisper compensation changes perceived loudness.

85eedcfc140ca942d8fae303c245bf83df8e52b7.source: 同一 a 构形的耳语近似，含默认 24 dB 试听补偿。响度不宜直接比较。
85eedcfc140ca942d8fae303c245bf83df8e52b7.translation: Whisper approximation with the same a configuration and default 24 dB compensation. Do not compare loudness directly.

daa7ad97d92fb310ce3d17778c101073a26a8587.source: 可以用同一构形比较不同声源，也可以保持浊声与 150 Hz，依次选择 a、u 后各发声 1 秒，听声道构形变化带来的差别。结合下面的例音观察构形与声音的对应关系。
daa7ad97d92fb310ce3d17778c101073a26a8587.translation: Compare sources with one configuration, or retain voiced 150 Hz and choose a then u, each phonating for 1 second, to hear vocal-tract differences. Use examples below to relate posture and sound.

7c9b866e7e25d9c628917f86b5d51fa1005e7372.source: 模型合成示例：a 构形，浊声，F0 150 Hz。
7c9b866e7e25d9c628917f86b5d51fa1005e7372.translation: Model synthesis: a configuration, voiced, F0 150 Hz.

f1f36a37e7f30af5cbe8c69e0fe81a4f30ee4dbf.source: 模型合成示例：u 构形，其余声源设置与 a 示例相同。
f1f36a37e7f30af5cbe8c69e0fe81a4f30ee4dbf.translation: Model synthesis: u configuration, other source settings matching a.

5f6fb8169c709df2b06a6a0c1889518d70618f19.source: 边听边看实时波形和语谱图
5f6fb8169c709df2b06a6a0c1889518d70618f19.translation: Inspect live waveform and spectrogram while listening

3acf902a0628bf76a7810f94da19579d717af680.source: 点击声学分析区的实时波形 · 语谱图，再手动发声。上方显示波形，下方显示该模块的实际输出语谱图，无需麦克风。
3acf902a0628bf76a7810f94da19579d717af680.translation: Click Live waveform · spectrogram in Acoustic analysis, then phonate manually. Waveform above and actual module-output spectrogram below require no microphone.

dca0e852e1504be347570892c0cfe69ccba0b368.source: 按观察目的选择显示时长、分析窗长和时间步长。按住 Ctrl 在波形或语谱图上滚动滚轮，以鼠标指向处缩放时间，两图同步，最短可查看 1 毫秒。放大波形后显示连续采样细节。波形纵轴默认自动调整并显示真实振幅刻度，也可选择 ±1 固定范围；这一设置不改变播放音量。双击恢复所选显示时长。需要看更大的图时，点击展开 ↗，展开后也可缩放。
dca0e852e1504be347570892c0cfe69ccba0b368.translation: Choose display duration, analysis window, and time step for the purpose. Ctrl + wheel over either plot zooms time near the pointer in both plots, down to 1 millisecond. Zoom reveals continuous samples. Waveform vertical axis defaults to automatic with real amplitude scales, or fixed ±1; this does not change playback volume. Double-click restores chosen duration. Expand ↗ opens a larger zoomable plot.

7b0917d37b6ca6272ff6b9010fdd9d2d2799ff06.source: 放大窗口中点击返回工作台或按 Esc 回来。收起只收起实时图，结束声音仍要使用停止播放，或放大窗口中的停止发声。
7b0917d37b6ca6272ff6b9010fdd9d2d2799ff06.translation: Click Return to workbench or Esc in the expanded view. Collapsing hides plots only; stop sound with Stop playback or Stop phonation in the expanded window.

39f7eaae5a2f1c42147c00023d3fd37de8cc11c8.source: 观察较长动作选更长时间。

c7bc0f36d65e089cccf65dd805bd12f4d14adf6b.source: 短窗便于看瞬时变化，长窗便于看邻近频率。
c7bc0f36d65e089cccf65dd805bd12f4d14adf6b.translation: Short windows for transient changes, long for nearby frequencies.

dadb5a5c680cfdeeea9706bf9d2a989a70622964.source: 实际步长可能因数据量调整，以状态行读数为准。
dadb5a5c680cfdeeea9706bf9d2a989a70622964.translation: Actual step may adapt to data volume; use status-line readouts.

01446fd23882053c21f7d274b7c38f4ea129feed.source: 图像反映送往设备的合成输出，包含试听音量、弱音增益和耳语补偿。停止后保留最后一段。语谱图纵轴为 0–6 kHz，浅色主题中较深的纹理表示较强能量，深色主题中较亮的纹理表示较强能量。
01446fd23882053c21f7d274b7c38f4ea129feed.translation: Plots reflect synthesis sent to the device, including listening volume, quiet-sound gain, and whisper compensation. Last segment remains after stopping. Spectrogram axis is 0–6 kHz. Darker textures mean more energy in light theme; brighter textures mean more in dark theme.

661c569da1beda0c9ed0ae5a24c51a210935ef24.source: 用音标保存和加载构形
661c569da1beda0c9ed0ae5a24c51a210935ef24.translation: Save and load configurations by phonetic symbol

45be20a9d8e925e5e61c1ebb807d280fa660fa30.source: 先调好器官、唇宽、手动舌根或自动舌根、声门高低、声源和 F0，等待构形更新结束。
45be20a9d8e925e5e61c1ebb807d280fa660fa30.translation: Set organs, lip width, manual/automatic tongue root, glottal height, source, and F0, then wait for updates to finish.

64a26bde07e80a6de69ebc46871ac85f2cee7c9d.source: 点击模型下方的保存构形，弹窗标题为保存构形 · 选择音标。已有构形的音标点亮，尚未保存的音标较暗，两类音标均可点击保存。辅音表、元音表和其他辅音可滚动查看；窄窗下辅音表可横向滚动。
64a26bde07e80a6de69ebc46871ac85f2cee7c9d.translation: Click Save configuration below the model, opening Save configuration · Choose phonetic symbol. Saved symbols are lit; unsaved symbols are dim. Either can be clicked to save. Scroll consonants, vowels, and other consonants; narrow windows support horizontal scrolling of consonants.

5c4950be559297bb6c624e3d8987379788fd5dff.source: 点击要用作名称的音标。出现 <s id="0">已保存…构形与声源设置</s> 提示后，构形已进入本机库。
5c4950be559297bb6c624e3d8987379788fd5dff.translation: Click the naming symbol. <s id="0">… configuration and source settings saved</s> confirms entry in the local library.

a485deacbfb03c49e9805e5aa8192c1a86bf9ecd.source: 表中没有所需组合时，点击右上方输入音标，在自定义音标中输入 ã、ãː 等，点击保存构形或按 Enter。输入须为不超过 80 字的单行文本。
a485deacbfb03c49e9805e5aa8192c1a86bf9ecd.translation: For combinations not in the table, click Enter symbol at upper right, type ã, ãː, etc. under Custom symbol, and Save configuration or Enter. Input must be a single line no longer than 80 characters.

ff1a13e428acc0818e4513df59a769f912db0a4e.source: <s id="0">同一音标再次保存会更新已有构形。</s>如果要同时保留两个版本，请使用不同名称。保存失败时，弹窗会保留并显示原因，处理后可再次点击保存，确认成功提示。
ff1a13e428acc0818e4513df59a769f912db0a4e.translation: <s id="0">Saving the same symbol again updates its existing configuration.</s> Use different names for two versions. On failure the dialog stays with a reason; resolve it, save again, and confirm success.

160e9354fb3a45ab373b0e4381e715a388a2ada3.source: 点击输入音标后填写 ã，再按保存构形。组合符号可完整保留。
160e9354fb3a45ab373b0e4381e715a388a2ada3.translation: After Enter symbol, type ã and Save configuration. Combining marks are preserved.

48d10f8355a50d370ebf3366cedd764f5ac61216.source: 红框中填写自定义音标，组合符号也可以完整保存。
48d10f8355a50d370ebf3366cedd764f5ac61216.translation: Custom phonetic-symbol input in the red box; combining marks can be saved intact.

fd1aa56ead297e8b9190225b6052508871ee8308.source: 点击已存构型打开音标表，内置和已保存的构形直接点亮。点击设置常用，再从内置或已存构型中选择加入或移出底部常用栏，★ 表示已选。点击完成常用设置后，点击音标载入构形。
fd1aa56ead297e8b9190225b6052508871ee8308.translation: Saved configurations opens the symbol table, lighting built-in and saved entries. Set favorites adds/removes built-in or saved configurations in the bottom favorites bar; ★ marks selected. Finish favorites setup, then click a symbol to load.

039d6fa7cb8991d25e55e63b4eca8de3fa6580fc.source: 点击已存音标，模型会载入其姿势，声源与 F0 一并恢复。自定义音标在其他辅音下方，直接点击即可。
039d6fa7cb8991d25e55e63b4eca8de3fa6580fc.translation: Click a saved symbol to restore posture, source, and F0 together. Custom symbols appear below Other consonants.

46c10b9bf46250950a3afe6360e06756cd3bab68.source: 载入后可继续调整，再用保存构形更新原音标或另存新名称。内置起点载入完整的器官构形、局部舌形与唇形、声源以及所选模型的默认基频。已保存记录则恢复记录中的值，缺少声源字段的旧记录保留当前声源。
46c10b9bf46250950a3afe6360e06756cd3bab68.translation: After loading, adjust the posture and save it under the same symbol or a new name. Built-in starting points load a complete articulatory configuration, local tongue and lip shapes, the source and the selected model's default fundamental frequency. Saved records restore their recorded values; old records without a source field retain the current source.

3fc61e2e89ac68ca9b39904ab403cc3fd6dbfb6f.source: 音标库按名称保存当前构形，方便下次加载；关键帧需在序列页签单独添加。
3fc61e2e89ac68ca9b39904ab403cc3fd6dbfb6f.translation: The symbol library stores the current configuration by name for later loading. Add keyframes separately in the Sequence tab.

3ddc2b0d42c4fc9fb1321d486b616676ebd7a870.source: 保存过的构形在表中有标记。点击音标可恢复构形与声源设置。
3ddc2b0d42c4fc9fb1321d486b616676ebd7a870.translation: Saved configurations are marked in the table; click symbols to restore posture/source.

869658709cf00aaa6dee285115d21e5e63c979d1.source: 把多个姿势排成连续发音

589b62abee71f651e9c4139f9c1d5c6bcacd0963.source: 摆出第一个姿势，在声音页签设置声源和 F0，然后切到序列，点击＋ 保存当前姿势。新卡片默认 0.2 秒。
589b62abee71f651e9c4139f9c1d5c6bcacd0963.translation: Set the first posture, select its source and F0 in the Sound tab, then open Sequence and click + Capture current posture. A new card defaults to 0.2 seconds.

75689b9ec4e6115a056c303e34c8170cd1ae3b2d.source: 继续摆出下一个姿势并保存，一个关键帧即可播放或保存动作视频。单个普通帧会按停留时长保持构形并发声，单个静音帧保持构形并输出静音。每张构形卡片保存当时的器官、舌面与舌底局部调整、唇宽、舌根模式、声门高低、声源和 F0。
75689b9ec4e6115a056c303e34c8170cd1ae3b2d.translation: Set and save another posture. One keyframe suffices for playback or motion video: a normal frame holds posture and phonates for its dwell; one silence frame holds posture silently. Configuration cards store organs, local surface/underside tongue changes, lip width, root mode, glottal height, source, and F0.

d04815e1a186d4ff591c02398dc6a66fe7d057f5.source: 可直接修改卡片名称，再在秒数输入框填写时长，单帧允许 0.05–3 秒。填写完成后离开输入框，让设置生效。
d04815e1a186d4ff591c02398dc6a66fe7d057f5.translation: Edit card names directly and duration in seconds, allowing 0.05–3 seconds per frame. Finish and leave the field to apply.

5d03f462ff9585d96bfb5684b73193480af76d1b.source: <s id="0">普通帧的过渡秒数是从这一帧走到下一帧的时间；最后一帧的停留秒数是保持末姿势的时间。</s>桌面与浏览器本地计算单次动作总计不超过 60 秒，服务器回退不超过 5 秒。列表可保留更多姿势，超过当前上限时先缩短时长或移除部分帧，才能播放和保存动作视频。
5d03f462ff9585d96bfb5684b73193480af76d1b.translation: <s id="0">A normal frame's transition duration is the time to reach the following frame; the final frame's hold duration maintains the last posture.</s> A sequence can last up to 60 seconds on desktop or with local browser computation, and up to 5 seconds with the server fallback. The list can retain more postures, but shorten or remove frames to meet the active limit before playback or video export.

3d6141d817adbcb70fbffdd6b2f563004666b344.source: 点击卡片空白处或标题按钮载入该姿势。修改当前模型不会自动覆盖已保存的卡片。
3d6141d817adbcb70fbffdd6b2f563004666b344.translation: Click card blank space or its title button to load the posture. Changing the current model does not overwrite a saved card automatically.

03f0cf4ea019a7e96040210f38dcd0c00a86adca.source: 要修改已有卡片，点其编辑，切到器官或声音页签调整，再回来点击这张卡片的保存。点取消会恢复原卡片姿势。先保存或取消，才能编辑另一张卡片。
03f0cf4ea019a7e96040210f38dcd0c00a86adca.translation: Click Edit on a card, adjust in Organs/Sound, then return and Save that card. Cancel restores the original card posture. Save or cancel before editing another card.

f1e5b4ae9ae98a57e035053340b0951ec535efff.source: 拖动卡片空白处或时间旁的 ⠿ 标记上下排序，拖到列表边缘会自动滚动。也可点 ← / → 前移、后移，或让卡片获得焦点后按 Alt+上/下方向键。
f1e5b4ae9ae98a57e035053340b0951ec535efff.translation: Drag card blank space or ⠿ beside time to reorder; list edges autoscroll. Alternatively use ← / →, or focus the card and Alt+up/down.

77347227af1ec3a4cd2cc475ceac3ab27a2f79ed.source: 移除只移除对应卡片。清空列表会同时清除整段关键帧和手绘 F0；误清空后立即点撤销清空可恢复，开始新建或编辑后该入口结束。
77347227af1ec3a4cd2cc475ceac3ab27a2f79ed.translation: Remove affects one card. Clear list removes all keyframes and drawn F0; Undo clear immediately restores it, until new creation/editing ends that option.

efb4ae0cd3a3bf9f3d7397d66f646c91e97202e0.source: 排序、改名、改时长后，卡片时间区间和下方 F0 画布的名称与分界线会同步变化。列表不分页，内容较多时在列表内滚动。
efb4ae0cd3a3bf9f3d7397d66f646c91e97202e0.translation: Reorder, rename, or duration edits synchronously update card intervals and F0-canvas names/boundaries. Lists have no pages; scroll within long lists.

0b48cccbdc29562ec23cc720b4bcf7f6e484381c.source: 编辑后可切到器官或声音页调整，返回动作页按保存；取消则恢复原帧。
0b48cccbdc29562ec23cc720b4bcf7f6e484381c.translation: Edit in Organs/Sound, return to motion and Save; Cancel restores the original frame.

09ff4d735ced8896343f843f04fae78e866933f7.source: 先摆出静音段的起始姿势，点击＋ 添加静音帧。
09ff4d735ced8896343f843f04fae78e866933f7.translation: Set the silence's starting posture, then + Add silence frame.

8dc5a62bbfb7708ad51063556d8c74ade180d616.source: 修改静音卡片的秒数与名称，再移动到需要的位置。后面还有关键帧时，器官在静音段内按普通帧的平滑动程移至下一姿势，全段仍不发声。末尾或单独的静音帧保持构形。
8dc5a62bbfb7708ad51063556d8c74ade180d616.translation: Change silence-card duration/name and move it. With a following keyframe, organs smoothly move to it during silence using normal-frame motion, remaining silent throughout. Last or sole silence frames hold posture.

7adc7f9c9ec0418010c705cdcfb5511954b21fc0.source: 观察 F0 图中的灰色留白区。静音段无基频，鼠标和键盘都不能在其中绘制 F0。
7adc7f9c9ec0418010c705cdcfb5511954b21fc0.translation: Inspect gray blanks in the F0 plot. Silence has no fundamental frequency; neither mouse nor keyboard can draw F0 there.

97d8214429cb562d78ab51483099814e0fef7f0c.source: 静音帧是明确指定的时间段。器官形成闭塞时是否仍有声音，则由模型和口鼻通路共同决定，两者应分别观察。静音类型会随关键帧文件和本机草稿一起保存。
97d8214429cb562d78ab51483099814e0fef7f0c.translation: Silence frames explicitly specify intervals. Sound during an organ-induced closure depends on the model and oral/nasal paths; inspect separately. Silence type saves with keyframe files/local drafts.

3a8882c0721e74cf2947fcf0ff6568d5f9f829e0.source: 三帧依次为 a、静音和 u。普通帧的时间表示过渡，最后一帧表示停留。
3a8882c0721e74cf2947fcf0ff6568d5f9f829e0.translation: Three frames a, silence, u. Normal-frame time means transition; the final frame means dwell.

dab76f734b96a6374be03580616ab6115b97e4d8.source: 中间这一帧标为静音，时间是 0.3 秒；末帧标为停留。
dab76f734b96a6374be03580616ab6115b97e4d8.translation: Middle frame marked Silence at 0.3 seconds; final frame marked Dwell.

ddbe01352e64c636a674b4f8fec8edd3e5c5d76b.source: 为连续发音绘制基频与气压曲线
ddbe01352e64c636a674b4f8fec8edd3e5c5d76b.translation: Draw fundamental-frequency and pressure curves for a sequence

733f6f9ef1a327b762ecd8a54b31b78119ae8c66.source: 准备至少一个关键帧，在序列下方展开手绘基频与气压，选择基频或气压绘制模式。两条曲线分别编辑和撤销。需要更宽画布时点击放大绘制 ↗。
733f6f9ef1a327b762ecd8a54b31b78119ae8c66.translation: Prepare at least one keyframe, expand Draw fundamental frequency and pressure below the sequence, and choose fundamental frequency or pressure mode. The curves have separate edits and undo histories. Click Enlarge drawing ↗ for a wider canvas.

8f87bec179933fe3131606e66d59f8fc89af13e4.source: 尚未手绘时，虚线表示每个姿势保存的 F0 及其过渡。横轴覆盖整段时长，顶部标出帧名称、起止时间和分界线，纵轴为 60–350 Hz。
8f87bec179933fe3131606e66d59f8fc89af13e4.translation: Before drawing, dashed lines show saved F0 and transitions. Time spans the whole motion, frame names/times/boundaries appear above, and vertical range is 60–350 Hz.

e6e1f619a0efcba2c54dfddfd9011653f6e09184.source: 在非静音区域按住鼠标绘制，实线表示启用的手绘曲线。可只重画一小段，也可从右向左修改，未画到的部分保持原曲线。
e6e1f619a0efcba2c54dfddfd9011653f6e09184.translation: Drag in nonsilent areas; solid lines indicate enabled drawn curves. Redraw portions or work right-to-left; untouched parts retain the original curve.

c3d3124382cb06df0825200fdac312cb0155c8f3.source: 撤销笔画恢复当前模式的上一笔，恢复逐帧基频或恢复逐帧气压停用相应手绘曲线。画布获得焦点后，Ctrl+Z 撤销笔画，左右方向键移动时间位置；上下方向键按基频模式的 5 Hz 或气压模式的 20 Pa 微调。
c3d3124382cb06df0825200fdac312cb0155c8f3.translation: Undo stroke restores the previous stroke in the selected mode. Restore per-frame fundamental frequency or pressure disables the respective drawn curve. With the canvas focused, Ctrl+Z undoes a stroke and the left and right arrows move in time. The up and down arrows adjust fundamental frequency by 5 Hz or pressure by 20 Pa, according to the mode.

2a3e8e7c68619f97889747b48e6de7dab2929310.source: 点击播放动作与声音试听。手绘曲线只用于关键帧动作，持续发声仍使用声音页签中的当前 F0。
2a3e8e7c68619f97889747b48e6de7dab2929310.translation: Play motion and sound to listen. Drawing affects keyframe motion only; continuous phonation uses current Sound-tab F0.

1e022ffd0c57b81ddab68a4877bccf454d7dc899.source: <s id="0">修改总时长后，手绘 F0 随整段时间等比例伸缩。</s>排序或增减姿势后，它也沿整段时间轴解释，不会自动固定在原来的某张卡片上。需要把转折对齐到某一姿势时，按新的分界线重画。
1e022ffd0c57b81ddab68a4877bccf454d7dc899.translation: <s id="0">Changing total duration proportionally stretches drawn F0 over the full motion.</s> Reordering or adding/removing postures also interprets it across total time, not attached to an original card. Redraw against new boundaries to align turns with postures.

e5a8a2f59f284d1e00bcc627a5beeeb014e7f9dd.source: 在非静音段拖动绘制 F0。灰色静音段不接受绘制，撤销笔画可退回上一步。
e5a8a2f59f284d1e00bcc627a5beeeb014e7f9dd.translation: Drag F0 in nonsilent areas. Gray silence rejects drawing; Undo stroke returns one step.

40bc959016f94b6a84c4b0803da2a0fb554e9f51.source: 清声和耳语无周期振动的部分不执行音高控制。画面中保留的 F0 是编辑轨迹；重新进入有振动的段落后再沿轨迹发声。静音灰区始终留白。
40bc959016f94b6a84c4b0803da2a0fb554e9f51.translation: Unvoiced/whisper portions without periodic vibration do not apply pitch control. Displayed F0 remains an editing track; vibration resumes along it when periodic sections return. Gray silence remains blank.

19007922ab280fbbe2e5052a98b24424ce4068e7.source: 练习：a、静音与 u 的连续动作
19007922ab280fbbe2e5052a98b24424ce4068e7.translation: Exercise: a, silence, and u motion

660c2aa0db5d8b274e6b072d98113ddb97697fcc.source: 选择浊声 · 周期振动，将 F0 设为 150 Hz，保持合适试听音量。选构形起点 a，保存当前姿势并把第一帧过渡改为 0.8 秒。
660c2aa0db5d8b274e6b072d98113ddb97697fcc.translation: Select Voiced · periodic vibration, F0 150 Hz, and suitable volume. Choose a, save posture, and set first transition to 0.8 seconds.

313f76870075798c23cc948923a5976ebf43b9f5.source: 当前仍为 a 时添加静音帧，将静音改为 0.3 秒。随后选 u 并保存第三帧，将末帧停留改为 0.5 秒。检查顺序为 a、静音、u，总长 1.6 秒。
313f76870075798c23cc948923a5976ebf43b9f5.translation: Still at a, add a silence frame at 0.3 seconds. Select u, save a third frame, and set final dwell 0.5 seconds. Check a, silence, u in order, total 1.6 seconds.

5eb41674a2ef8592024d5c8286ea1fb452f303c6.source: 点击播放动作与声音，等待正在生成声音与同步画面的提示结束。播放时进度条与模型一起更新；正常结束保留最后姿势。
5eb41674a2ef8592024d5c8286ea1fb452f303c6.translation: Play motion and sound; wait for Generating sound and synchronized images to finish. Progress and model update together; normal completion leaves the last posture.

f7301496424d7bbac9b04a4c3551a6b5f882c6c0.source: 需要中断时点击停止。播放期间器官和声源编辑暂时锁定，仍可旋转、平移或缩放视图。
f7301496424d7bbac9b04a4c3551a6b5f882c6c0.translation: Stop to interrupt. Organ/source editing locks during playback, while view rotation, pan, and zoom remain available.

da0b050458730aaa8a9cbf2e2f0185bb5df56711.source: 再次播放同一序列，或在非静音区手绘从约 120 Hz 上升到 200 Hz 的轨迹再播放，比较音高变化。保持静音段留白。
da0b050458730aaa8a9cbf2e2f0185bb5df56711.translation: Replay the same sequence, or draw a rise from about 120 Hz to 200 Hz outside silence and compare. Leave silence blank.

f29e427931eb70d205f1ededd3049e0e43c557a8.source: 这段练习中，第一普通帧在 0.8 秒内过渡到静音帧保存的构形，静音段内再用 0.3 秒平滑移至 u 且不发声，末帧 u 保持 0.5 秒并发声。可按需要改姿势与时长，再听新的结果。
f29e427931eb70d205f1ededd3049e0e43c557a8.translation: The first normal frame transitions over 0.8 seconds to the silence frame's saved posture; during silence it moves smoothly to u over 0.3 seconds without sound; final u holds and phonates for 0.5 seconds. Edit posture/duration to hear another result.

0fe26b008d34236dbea2fe25867f353be2f23f84.source: 三帧动作：a 0.8 秒、静音 0.3 秒、u 0.5 秒，F0 150 Hz。
0fe26b008d34236dbea2fe25867f353be2f23f84.translation: Three-frame motion: a 0.8 seconds, silence 0.3 seconds, u 0.5 seconds, F0 150 Hz.

0a65448a63b94ea7113b5b1c8d28fee15d1386f6.source: 同一三帧动作，使用截图中实际手绘的 F0 曲线，静音段仍保持静音。
0a65448a63b94ea7113b5b1c8d28fee15d1386f6.translation: Same three-frame motion with the actually drawn F0 shown in the screenshot; silence remains silent.

3e056f71782402f509539513d62a43c16c4fe023.source: 姿势、时长、声源和 F0 未变时，再次播放可复用本会话已经准备的动作与音频。重新打开工作台后首次播放仍需要准备。准备或播放失败时，查看关键帧状态行，调整设置后重新播放。
3e056f71782402f509539513d62a43c16c4fe023.translation: With unchanged posture, duration, source, and F0, replay can reuse motion/audio prepared in this session. First playback after reopening prepares again. On preparation/playback failure, inspect the keyframe status line, adjust, and replay.

0e0b6d4d268798db6d3ff03e669f8c01ee8cca3e.source: 保存关键帧文件与带声音的视频
0e0b6d4d268798db6d3ff03e669f8c01ee8cca3e.translation: Save keyframes and videos with sound

b3d43f7f5c7b6f030a0323d0a89f0db35a715496.source: 需要保留或交换动作时，点击导出关键帧，在本机保存对话框选择位置，保存为 .ptb-vocal.json。
b3d43f7f5c7b6f030a0323d0a89f0db35a715496.translation: Export keyframes opens a local save dialog for a .ptb-vocal.json motion file.

f0abbf61dfe4d03ce253fd543642c5ab7e45b817.source: 该文件保存名称、顺序、时长、器官参数、声源、静音类型、塞音时序、手绘基频与气压、全局构音调整、区段特征及整段微扰设置。关闭再打开模块时，当前模型的本机草稿也会恢复；另存文件更方便整理和备份。
f0abbf61dfe4d03ce253fd543642c5ab7e45b817.translation: The file stores names, order, durations, articulatory parameters, source settings, silence types, stop timing, drawn fundamental frequency and pressure, global articulatory adjustments, scoped features and sequence-wide perturbation settings. Reopening the module also restores the current model's local draft. Export a file for easier organisation and backup.

454a9f3eb1d9ef12dee0baaa9bf6f9644d1d0356.source: 要载入另一段动作，先导出当前需要保留的序列，再点击导入关键帧选择文件。<s id="0">导入成功会整体替换当前序列。</s>
454a9f3eb1d9ef12dee0baaa9bf6f9644d1d0356.translation: To load another motion, export current work first, then Import keyframes. <s id="0">Successful import replaces the whole current sequence.</s>

17f9cbb687cea4c9113fe1b34b0ce76d2f1dfc05.source: 文件损坏、版本或模型不匹配、参数越界时会拒绝导入，并提示当前序列保留。取消文件选择也保留当前内容。
17f9cbb687cea4c9113fe1b34b0ce76d2f1dfc05.translation: Corruption, incompatible versions/models, or out-of-range values are rejected with Current sequence retained. Cancelled selection also retains it.

3dc3eb1782716d1860b3b6ef60a79484474de417.source: 当前导出采用版本 8，并记录几何方法 m10/r21、JD2 或 W02 模型身份及截面数。版本 1–8 可按对应规则读取，模型必须与当前所选模型一致。旧版参数保留并按当前几何重算，面积和声音可能改变；截面数不同时也会提示。新文件需用支持其版本与功能的软件打开。
3dc3eb1782716d1860b3b6ef60a79484474de417.translation: Current exports use version 8 and record geometry method m10/r21, the JD2 or W02 model identity and section count. Versions 1–8 are read under their respective rules, and the model must match the current selection. Legacy parameters are preserved and recalculated with the current geometry, so areas and sound may change. A different section count also produces a notice. Open new files with software that supports their version and features.

df55ad3d56916e828959f1a717ca8b77dddc4317.source: 关键帧文件容量上限为 8 MB，只保存动作与控制数据；声音与画面保存在导出的视频中。旧文件中的局部舌形和独立送气帧仍可读取，新文件还可保存独立唇形、塞音时序和区段特征。
df55ad3d56916e828959f1a717ca8b77dddc4317.translation: Keyframe files are limited to 8 MB and contain motion and control data. Sound and images are stored in exported videos. Local tongue shapes and standalone aspiration frames in legacy files remain readable; new files can also store independent lip shapes, stop timing and scoped features.

4eee7fe81d5570454a9c1a3ca9a93bc3ff079e33.source: 确认至少有一个关键帧，当前桌面或浏览器本地计算的总长不超过 60 秒，服务器回退不超过 5 秒，且已有卡片编辑已保存或取消。点击保存动作视频。
4eee7fe81d5570454a9c1a3ca9a93bc3ff079e33.translation: Check that there is at least one keyframe, the total is within 60 seconds for desktop or local browser computation, or 5 seconds for the server fallback, and any card edit has been saved or cancelled. Click Save motion video.

2735037a9af3896dd3a60cdab8cb3416c551a493.source: 在画面中选择当前视图或全部六视图 · 2 × 3。当前视图保留所选二维或三维、显示模式和观察方向，输出 1280 × 720；六视图输出 1920 × 1080，上排二维、下排三维，每排依次是器官、气腔、叠加观察。
2735037a9af3896dd3a60cdab8cb3416c551a493.translation: Choose Current view or All six views · 2 × 3. Current view retains chosen two/three-dimensional mode, display style, and orientation at 1280 × 720. Six views use 1920 × 1080, upper row two-dimensional, lower three-dimensional, each ordered Organs, Airway, Overlay.

ae05989a73ddfd5c9338bd942c64ddad7748d0e7.source: 点击选择位置并导出，在本机保存对话框指定 .mp4 文件。等待准备动作与音频、逐帧导出的进度完成。
ae05989a73ddfd5c9338bd942c64ddad7748d0e7.translation: Choose location and export, specify .mp4, and wait for motion/audio preparation and framewise-export progress.

467ca5bdc1a0cf967023871c16415d02670cd604.source: 看到已保存文件名、帧数和秒数后，到所选位置打开视频。视频为 30 帧/秒，带同步音轨、姿势名称、时间区间、F0 曲线与时间游标。
467ca5bdc1a0cf967023871c16415d02670cd604.translation: After saved filename, frame count, and seconds appear, open the video at that location. It uses 30 frames/second with synchronized audio, posture names, time intervals, F0 curve, and time cursor.

cdf213473f778046fc1c45b1c0c69a0414dfa2f3.source: <s id="0">视频音轨使用当前试听音量、弱音增益和声源补偿。</s>保存前先检查音量，尤其避免把试听音量保持为 0。导出期间无需让扬声器发声。需要中断时点击取消导出，取消或失败不会替换已有目标文件。
cdf213473f778046fc1c45b1c0c69a0414dfa2f3.translation: <s id="0">Video audio uses current listening volume, quiet-sound gain, and source compensation.</s> Check volume before saving, especially avoiding 0. Speakers need not sound during export. Cancel export interrupts; cancellation/failure does not replace an existing target.

abb26f3f6413713259a4fb00fde4b5e14ab958e9.source: 选择当前视图或全部六视图后，再选择位置并导出同步声音的视频。图示为早期 WebM 界面，当前默认保存 MP4。
abb26f3f6413713259a4fb00fde4b5e14ab958e9.translation: Choose current or six views, then location/export for synchronized sound. The illustration shows an early WebM interface; current default is MP4.

3c307e54012fa893a236e06e6544eaa0a2eb0960.source: 本模块当前提供音频试听和带同步音轨的视频保存，没有独立的 WAV 保存按钮。要反复修改动作，保留关键帧文件；要分享声音和模型演示，保存 MP4（H.264 视频、AAC 音轨）视频。
3c307e54012fa893a236e06e6544eaa0a2eb0960.translation: Current features provide audio listening and synchronized-audio video, with no independent WAV save button. Keep keyframes for repeated edits; save MP4 (H.264 video, AAC audio) for sharing sound/model demonstrations.

c94cb70dd4d766487296ac85ed165640e89de84e.source: 切换模型会重新加载对应声道与声源，等待构形更新完成后再试听。两种模型共用参考头部轮廓的展示方式，模型差异应结合声道构形、面积和实际输出判断。
c94cb70dd4d766487296ac85ed165640e89de84e.translation: Switching models reloads the corresponding tract and source. Wait for the configuration to finish updating before previewing. Both models use the same reference-head display approach. Assess differences using the tract configuration, areas and actual output.

52d97087b4d8639c8d203269b5c7027d8aef3fcc.source: 整理构型套装与交换文件
52d97087b4d8639c8d203269b5c7027d8aef3fcc.translation: Organise configuration sets and exchange files

5f8206c7fcd3aea6b0cf1b2cd68dbc5701fc22c0.source: 打开已存构型或保存构形，在构型套装中选择当前套装。填写套装名称后，可新建空套装、复制当前套装或重命名。套装名称和自定义音标作为自己的数据保留，切换界面语言不会翻译或改名。
5f8206c7fcd3aea6b0cf1b2cd68dbc5701fc22c0.translation: Open Saved configurations or Save configuration and select the active configuration set. Enter a set name to create an empty set, copy the current set or rename it. Set names and custom symbols are your data: changing the interface language does not translate or rename them.

be7dc230293c2ae3e3f1de0c28037cdf55faade1.source: 当前套装决定构形保存、载入和从国际音标生成时使用的构形。切换套装不会改写已经添加的关键帧。需要删除个别记录时，展开管理已存构型并核对名称后操作。
be7dc230293c2ae3e3f1de0c28037cdf55faade1.translation: The active set determines the configurations used for saving, loading and generation from IPA. Switching sets does not rewrite existing keyframes. To delete an individual record, expand Manage saved configurations and check its name before proceeding.

61e68846791b0f303ec758b35e1f9ae5c257b070.source: 构型套装可导出为 .ptb-poses.json。导入前先核对模型、套装名称和音标列表；可作为新套装导入，也可合并到当前套装。合并遇到同名音标时明确选择保留已有或替换。导入确认前不会写入库，几何版本不同会提示按当前模型重算。
61e68846791b0f303ec758b35e1f9ae5c257b070.translation: Export a configuration set as .ptb-poses.json. Before importing, check the model, set name and symbol list. Import it as a new set or merge it into the active set, explicitly keeping existing or replacing matching symbols. Nothing is written to the library before confirmation. A different geometry version produces a notice that the current model will recalculate it.

d9adddf60bbfce3c084196ec3c4ebfb8a280e471.source: 在序列页签的从国际音标生成中输入已存在于当前构型套装的音标。可以输入 a i u，也可以连续输入已存音标。解析按已存名称的最长匹配进行；空白用于分隔，不会自动生成静音。需要停顿时另加静音帧。
d9adddf60bbfce3c084196ec3c4ebfb8a280e471.translation: In Generate from IPA on the Sequence tab, enter symbols available in the active configuration set. Enter a i u or concatenate saved symbols. Parsing uses the longest matching saved name. Whitespace separates symbols and does not create silence; add an explicit silence frame for a pause.

abae3e8ee4b39c74ad2db6a851f5781b7ff8f0d6.source: 初始时长可选按音标类型或统一设置。按类型的起点为塞音 80 ms、浊擦音 160 ms、清擦音 180 ms、元音 200 ms；统一时长为 0.05–3 秒。它们是便于编辑的模型初值，生成后可逐项修改。
abae3e8ee4b39c74ad2db6a851f5781b7ff8f0d6.translation: Choose initial durations by symbol type or use a uniform duration. Type-based starting values are 80 ms for stops, 160 ms for voiced fricatives, 180 ms for voiceless fricatives and 200 ms for vowels. Uniform duration is 0.05–3 seconds. These are editable model starting values; adjust each item after generation.

cc01c89b622420393532c9204cedd39ec0eb1243.source: 点击添加到序列会把结果追加到已有列表。存在未保存构形的音标时，提示会列出缺项，本次不追加部分结果。先在当前套装保存相应构形，再生成。保留塞音使用闭塞与快速释放时序的勾选，可直接进入卡片的塞音时序编辑。
cc01c89b622420393532c9204cedd39ec0eb1243.translation: Click Add to sequence to append the result to the existing list. If symbols lack saved configurations, the notice lists them and no partial result is appended. Save those configurations in the active set before generating again. Leave stop closure and rapid-release timing enabled to edit stop timing directly on the resulting cards.

32edfa2d67ce789a448c93451ba7b383bea45ece.source: 分别编辑闭塞、释放、送气与 VOT
32edfa2d67ce789a448c93451ba7b383bea45ece.translation: Edit closure, release, aspiration and VOT separately

2e5366a2d27343f48322e1fee53940f1a417f047.source: 普通构形卡片中的塞音时序可设置闭塞 10–2999 ms、释放 1–50 ms、送气 0–1000 ms，合计不超过 3 秒。闭塞保持本帧构形，释放快速移向下一构形，后续送气时段使用清声。先把下一张普通构形卡片设为希望的释放目标。
2e5366a2d27343f48322e1fee53940f1a417f047.translation: Stop timing in a normal configuration card allows closure of 10–2999 ms, release of 1–50 ms and aspiration of 0–1000 ms, totalling no more than 3 seconds. Closure holds the current configuration, release moves rapidly towards the next, and aspiration uses an unvoiced source. First set the following normal configuration card to the intended release target.

02d45014a581f4310172bebc4cb70522a088bf97.source: VOT 为浊音起始时刻减去释放时刻。负值表示闭塞期预浊，不能早于闭塞起点；正值表示释放后的浊音起始。修改送气时长会更新正 VOT，修改 VOT 也会联动送气时长。卡片会显示释放、浊音起始与结束的具体时间。
02d45014a581f4310172bebc4cb70522a088bf97.translation: VOT is voicing onset time minus release time. A negative value specifies prevoicing during closure and cannot precede closure onset; a positive value places voicing onset after release. Editing aspiration duration updates positive VOT, and editing VOT also updates aspiration duration. The card displays release, voicing onset and end times.

5a6f8b8b1021d262067e54abdc005569833b86c9.source: 这里的 VOT 是模型控制的时间关系。实际波形中的释放与周期起始还受构形、气压和声源设置影响，需要声学 VOT 时请从实际输出另行测量。
5a6f8b8b1021d262067e54abdc005569833b86c9.translation: Here VOT is a timing relation in the model controls. Acoustic release and periodicity onset also depend on configuration, pressure and source settings. Measure the actual output separately when acoustic VOT is required.

e4429c93121c91296bf04da130334a3a4887909b.source: 绘制气压并控制声源微扰
e4429c93121c91296bf04da130334a3a4887909b.translation: Draw pressure and control source perturbations

e0d1753fc6517cb46131efccff7e4522b3f44182.source: 手绘气压范围为 0–1600 Pa，橙色曲线与蓝色基频曲线分别编辑。未启用手绘时使用各帧声源气压；恢复逐帧气压可停用手绘曲线。静音帧始终静音，旧送气帧可有气压但不执行基频。改变总时长时，手绘气压与基频一样沿整段等比例伸缩。
e0d1753fc6517cb46131efccff7e4522b3f44182.translation: Draw pressure from 0–1600 Pa. The orange pressure curve and blue fundamental-frequency curve are edited separately. Without a drawn curve, each frame uses its source pressure; Restore per-frame pressure disables the drawn curve. Silence frames remain silent. Legacy aspiration frames can carry pressure but do not use fundamental frequency. When total duration changes, pressure and fundamental-frequency drawings scale across the whole sequence.

12f23eb2a65abcbf889c864aa554a4d493240b38.source: 声音页签的声源抖动分别控制基频抖动 jitter 与振幅抖动 shimmer，强度为 0–100，模型默认分别为 10 和 0。这些数值是合成控制强度，不能直接作为测量得到的百分比指标解释。
12f23eb2a65abcbf889c864aa554a4d493240b38.translation: Source perturbations in the Sound tab separately control fundamental-frequency jitter and amplitude shimmer. Strength is 0–100, with model defaults of 10 and 0 respectively. These are synthesis-control strengths and should not be interpreted directly as measured percentage indices.

4d26377d3df8fd5c036d6e422b3957d633258e76.source: 随机种子可设为 0–4294967295 的整数。同一参数与同一种子可重复生成相同随机变化，持续发声中改变构形会延续随机序列。整段微扰设置随关键帧文件保存；比较条件时同时记录曲线、强度与种子。
4d26377d3df8fd5c036d6e422b3957d633258e76.translation: Set the random seed to an integer from 0–4294967295. Identical parameters and seed reproduce the same random variation. Changing posture during continuous phonation continues the random sequence. Sequence-wide perturbation settings are stored in the keyframe file. Record curves, strengths and seed when comparing conditions.

0e4fceed8bb2404f2c755dcd9d975aac5d0e74dc.source: 全局构音调整与区段超音段特征
0e4fceed8bb2404f2c755dcd9d975aac5d0e74dc.translation: Global articulatory adjustments and scoped suprasegmental features

38830c44dcbdb27e44e53c025e054328bf23995e.source: 在全局构音调整中选择参数，点击添加调整，再选择固定为或相对偏移并填写数值。它在合成时作用于整段各姿势，原始构型记录保持不变；恢复全部原值可清除全局调整。参数的单位与范围在控件旁显示。
38830c44dcbdb27e44e53c025e054328bf23995e.translation: Choose a parameter in Global articulatory adjustments, click Add adjustment, then select a fixed value or relative offset and enter the value. It acts on all postures during synthesis while preserving the original configuration records. Restore all original values clears global adjustments. Units and limits appear beside the controls.

f87b4db00994767c5716e50e1ca6404988287463.source: 点击添加超音段特征，选择参数、调整方式和数值，再选择应用范围。选择关键帧按稳定帧身份记录，排序后随帧移动；起止时间按秒记录，排序后仍在原时间区间。保存后可勾选启用、编辑或移除。
f87b4db00994767c5716e50e1ca6404988287463.translation: Click Add suprasegmental feature, choose a parameter, adjustment mode and value, then select its scope. Keyframe selection records stable frame identities and follows reordering. Start and end times remain at their specified seconds after reordering. After saving, enable, edit or remove each feature.

fa9082227112bef1b60cd89732f21b4bf8c7fddd.source: 同一区段重叠的相对偏移相加；固定值冲突时采用后添加的一项，再叠加偏移并限制在参数边界内。全局与区段控制在姿势插值后、组织接触约束前执行。编辑后结合实际构形、面积和输出检查结果，器官约束可能限制最终接受的调整。
fa9082227112bef1b60cd89732f21b4bf8c7fddd.translation: Overlapping relative offsets add together. If fixed values conflict, the last added value is used, then offsets are added and the result is clipped to parameter bounds. Global and scoped controls act after posture interpolation and before tissue-contact constraints. Check the actual configuration, areas and output after editing; articulatory constraints may limit the accepted adjustment.

5170d5c675975a6a3cb717f2e03ec69912c3ac06.source: 模型尚未显示或载入失败
5170d5c675975a6a3cb717f2e03ec69912c3ac06.translation: Model not visible or load failed

50b5169bd8505c43e680cb90d9f8c3ed2d155c56.source: 先等后台准备。持续出现载入失败时，记下提示并从模块列表关闭后重新打开；使用包含本模块资源的完整桌面应用。
50b5169bd8505c43e680cb90d9f8c3ed2d155c56.translation: Wait for background preparation. Persistent failure: record the message, close/reopen from the module list, and use the complete desktop app containing module resources.

0e5700e766882cb06f2e526e0939063cf559be9c.source: 浏览器本地组件载入失败或功能受限
0e5700e766882cb06f2e526e0939063cf559be9c.translation: Browser computation component fails to load or functions are limited

d2c4cd5988f600131cf33414f57cb65899fcb4e7.source: 核对页面显示的计算方式与限制。首次本地组件加载失败会进入服务器回退；本地计算途中失败不会静默切换。记下提示，重试或重新打开页面，也可使用完整桌面应用。
d2c4cd5988f600131cf33414f57cb65899fcb4e7.translation: Check the computation mode and limits shown on the page. Initial failure to load the local component selects the server fallback; a failure during local computation does not switch silently. Record the message, retry or reopen the page, or use the full desktop application.

0c6c613c59d30cfee30ac4d488c92ccc1d0a358f.source: 到声音页签检查设备和试听音量，再低音量点击测试音。设备断开后重新选择。清声、耳语或低气压构形可很弱，先用浊声与 a 起点检查。
0c6c613c59d30cfee30ac4d488c92ccc1d0a358f.translation: Check device/volume in Sound, then Test tone at low volume. Reselect disconnected devices. Unvoiced, whisper, or low-pressure postures can be weak; test Voiced and a first.

10205474b8f3ec8cd2aab71a9a0b664a1555c896.source: 发声前提示构形还在更新

af9c968f8730f15e7ad15b8ded9119eca4452c56.source: 等待模型与声学图更新结束，再点击发声、保存构形或播放动作。
af9c968f8730f15e7ad15b8ded9119eca4452c56.translation: Wait for model/plots to finish before phonation, posture saving, or motion playback.

c741deeaf3268ac94c8cb6f9082d4962310562be.source: 查看器官约束提示。减小幅度或改另一项参数，再结合模型、面积图检查；用撤销恢复上一步。
c741deeaf3268ac94c8cb6f9082d4962310562be.translation: Inspect organ-constraint messages. Reduce movement or adjust another parameter, check model/area, and Undo if needed.

3ccfc8520fc78ac09d5868061e31f90bdd9f57ff.source: 横截面中央闭合却仍有声音

cf26ab4df27147498224e14a15f3fb148cedbe72.source: 检查两侧通路与腭咽口。隐藏鼻腔或牙齿只影响观察，不能替代通路设置。
cf26ab4df27147498224e14a15f3fb148cedbe72.translation: Check lateral paths and the port. Hiding nasal cavity/teeth affects viewing only and does not replace path settings.

702efae6351328096231ef4eeabf0c452e73e562.source: 播放或保存视频按钮不可用

06054ffb16e8a6bd74683869870bb9e5a1a5940e.source: 检查至少一个关键帧，桌面或浏览器本地计算总长不超过 60 秒，服务器回退不超过 5 秒，且没有正在编辑的卡片；先保存或取消编辑。
06054ffb16e8a6bd74683869870bb9e5a1a5940e.translation: Check for at least one keyframe, a total within 60 seconds on desktop or with local browser computation, or 5 seconds with the server fallback, and no unfinished card edit. Save or cancel the edit first.

c8301e9792f00c9ea8106cd5fb3cbf2bc65b7afa.source: 手绘 F0 没有效果

93848dbfc50ab8cdfe39dac19ce4e90a924f8b31.source: 使用播放动作与声音，并检查该段有周期振动。静音区不能画，清声和耳语无周期振动时也不执行音高控制。
93848dbfc50ab8cdfe39dac19ce4e90a924f8b31.translation: Use Play motion and sound and check periodic vibration in that interval. Silence cannot be drawn; unvoiced/whisper without periodic vibration has no pitch control.

bd156fa7093bcbd8cfb4bce0e552d324ae2e1a57.source: 立即点击撤销清空。新建或编辑后撤销入口会结束；已另存的序列也可重新导入。
bd156fa7093bcbd8cfb4bce0e552d324ae2e1a57.translation: Immediately Undo clear; creation/editing ends that option. Reimport separately saved sequences if available.

12115e8bd5f18b1c4857bcb8f9988f8d862eaa48.source: 构形或关键帧保存失败

ce98c91af22d059f691f209a523f67d0eed01ccd.source: 查看弹窗或关键帧状态行的原因，保留当前工作区，处理写入问题后重试，确认成功提示后核对保存文件。
ce98c91af22d059f691f209a523f67d0eed01ccd.translation: Inspect dialog/status reasons, retain the workspace, resolve writing issues, retry, and verify files after success.

a3dbd3d7f32caaeb426a70b54e6591772b6e451d.source: 当前序列会保留。重新选择有效的 .ptb-vocal.json，核对文件版本、模型和参数范围。
a3dbd3d7f32caaeb426a70b54e6591772b6e451d.translation: Current sequence remains. Select a valid .ptb-vocal.json and check version, model, and parameter ranges.

d4cd37e716f64f4042de71b5f37993b40077871d.source: 停止播放后图中保留最后一段；再次发声会开始新的输出。收起监测与停止声音是不同操作。
d4cd37e716f64f4042de71b5f37993b40077871d.translation: Plots retain the last segment after stopping; new phonation starts new output. Collapsing monitoring and stopping sound are separate actions.

5547c8b3a8c8dfb74e62486a87d1b709a96e5490.source: 记下视频状态行原因。确认输出位置可写，必要时重新导出；编码不受支持时使用新版桌面应用。
5547c8b3a8c8dfb74e62486a87d1b709a96e5490.translation: Record the video status reason, ensure a writable location, and retry. For unsupported encoding, use the updated desktop app.

45bd86becfe014e477423282db24b63c70a29940.source: 当前模型的序列、构型套装库与声音设置保存在本机用户目录的 keyframes.json、preset-libraries.json、audio-settings.json；旧 presets.json、favorites.json 仅用于兼容读取。网页按账号与项目保存于浏览器本地存储，清除站点数据会移除它们。重要动作与构型套装请另存文件，跨设备使用时显式导入。出现配置读取错误时，先备份原文件，再按提示处理。
45bd86becfe014e477423282db24b63c70a29940.translation: The current model's sequence, configuration-set library and audio settings are stored in keyframes.json, preset-libraries.json and audio-settings.json in the local user directory. Legacy presets.json and favorites.json are read for compatibility. Web data is stored locally in the browser by account and project; clearing site data removes it. Export important sequences and configuration sets, and import them explicitly on another device. If reading a configuration fails, back up the original file before following the message.

c1dd3d81b22a574c7d4676f941ec64dde941b048.source: 这套可调的声道与几何声门模型适合操作演示与模型探索。构形名称用于辨认姿势，参数描述模型几何；研究自然发音或个体解剖时需另行采集和测量。
c1dd3d81b22a574c7d4676f941ec64dde941b048.translation: This adjustable vocal-tract/geometric-glottis model supports demonstrations and exploration. Names identify postures; parameters describe model geometry. Natural speech and individual anatomy require separate collection/measurement.

a93a36f9e8b409b0865fb520274f94666121a8c7.source: 声道可选择男性 JD2 或女性 W02 模型，头部轮廓与平均鼻腔来自分别配准的参考模型。头部参考轮廓不代表每个模型或个体的精确解剖。当前声源按给定参数产生声音，声带组织的自主力学振动尚未建模。具体方法、来源与许可可从参数控制标题旁的方法与引用查看。
a93a36f9e8b409b0865fb520274f94666121a8c7.translation: Choose the male JD2 or female W02 vocal-tract model. The head outline and average nasal cavity come from separately registered reference models. The reference head outline is not an exact anatomical representation of each model or individual. The source generates sound from specified parameters; self-sustained mechanical vibration of vocal-fold tissue is not modelled. Open Methods and references beside the parameter controls for methods, sources and licences.

a620d5462407765c225bed2e38a9bd2a4a9b10cb.source: 比较实验条件时保留器官参数、声源、F0、帧时长以及音量和增益设置。F0 画布是合成控制轨迹，传递函数谱峰是模型计算结果。需要对输出作声学测量时，另行使用实际音频开展分析。
a620d5462407765c225bed2e38a9bd2a4a9b10cb.translation: Retain organs, source, F0, frame durations, volume, and gains for comparisons. F0 canvas is a synthesis-control track; transfer-function peaks are model calculations. Analyze actual audio separately for output acoustic measurements.

8006d47d78be747f4aee899ee15fd9ecb5f13865.source: 需要逐个截面查看时，先点击面积图使其获得焦点，再用左右方向键移动。Home、End 可到两端。桌面默认 65 个采样截面，包含两端的 64 段，可选 65、129 或 257 截面；浏览器本地计算也默认 65 截面，另可选 33、129 或 257 截面；服务器回退默认 33、可选 65 截面。选择会保存。更多截面增加计算量，切换会重算真实截面、中线、声管面积和传递函数，并重新准备动作缓存。低采样可能漏掉局部狭窄或改变谱峰，定量比较请固定并记录截面数。
8006d47d78be747f4aee899ee15fd9ecb5f13865.translation: To inspect sections individually, focus the area plot and use the left and right arrow keys; Home and End select its ends. Desktop defaults to 65 sections, including the ends of 64 intervals, with 65, 129 or 257 available. Local browser computation also defaults to 65 and additionally offers 33, 129 or 257. The server fallback defaults to 33 and also offers 65. The selection is saved. More sections increase computation; changing it recalculates cross-sections, the centreline, tube areas and transfer function, and prepares the motion cache again. Sparse sampling may miss a local constriction or shift spectral peaks. Keep the section count fixed and record it for quantitative comparisons.

7494f9d1db3dd996f68644e6db0b5739db3017f4.source: 在模型上方选择男性 JD2 或女性 W02。两种模型各自保留构型套装、常用栏和序列草稿，切换前先保存正在编辑的卡片。内置构形的默认基频分别为 120 Hz 和 200 Hz；加载已保存构形时使用记录中的基频。
7494f9d1db3dd996f68644e6db0b5739db3017f4.translation: Select male JD2 or female W02 above the model. Each model retains its own configuration sets, favourites and sequence draft. Save any card edit before switching. Built-in configurations default to 120 Hz and 200 Hz respectively; saved configurations use their recorded fundamental frequency.
